function.arguments: {"command":"cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && sed -n '1,220p' build.sh && cd fribidi && (command -v meson || true; command -v ninja || true; command -v clang || true; command -v gcc || true)"}
function.name: execute_bash

content:
build=$WORK/build
rm -rf $build
mkdir -p $build
meson --default-library=static --wrap-mode=nodownload -Ddocs=false       -Dfuzzer_ldflags="$(echo $LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE)"       $build   || (cat build/meson-logs/meson-log.txt && false)
ninja -v -j$(nproc) -C $build bin/fribidi-fuzzer
mv $build/bin/fribidi-fuzzer $OUT/
zip $OUT/fribidi-fuzzer_seed_corpus.zip test/*.{input,reference} test/fuzzing/*
/usr/bin/gcc
